modules.module_title: Carry out preparatory work prior to fixing of tiles

pcs.pc_description: read and interpret working sketches prior to laying of tiles
install button marks / level pads as per the tiling requirements using common reference line

check the basic attributes of the base surface such as compactness, squareness or right-angle slope or fall (in case of floors surface), hacking on surfaces (in case of RCC structure & walls), and completion of embedded surfaces (including MEP)
clean and wet base surfaces with water jets (except wood/vinyl )for better adhesion of tiles
soak tiles in water as per manufacturers specification, if required
prepare various surfaces as per requirement for different types of tiles such as masonry plastered surface, reinforced concrete surface, concrete block timber, and vinyl surface

modules.module_title: Check that the tiles are as per the specifications

pcs.pc_description: check for basic attributes of the tiles like color, shade, size and squareness before commencement of work
check batch number of all tiles to be used in order to avoid variations in shade, color or pattern
ensure that any protective layer on the tiles is removed prior to use
check for any damages / cracks on the tiles prior to use
ensure tiles are cleaned appropriately prior to fixing

modules.module_title: Measure & cut tiles as per the design, shape and size requirements

pcs.pc_description: carry out proper marking before cutting tiles to required shape and size
cut tiles as per the design /pattern specifications using appropriate tools to fit around obstacles & into odd spaces & corners
minimize wastage of tiles

modules.module_title: Lay and fix both natural and processed tiles on wall & floors

pcs.pc_description: specify the centre-point or starting point of the surface for tiling as per working drawings/sketches
ensure the preparation of bed mortar, cement slurry, cement paste and adhesives is as per specifications / requirements of tiling works
identify the laying position of tiles as per arrow marks on the tile box
maintain consistency of batch number of all tiles
prepare a bedding of appropriate thickness to act as base for fixing tiles
apply & spread cement mortar, mastic, glue or other adhesives on the base of tile using appropriate tools for fixing tiles
install roof tiles by bedding and pointing in cement mortar or by mechanical means
check for hollowness of tiled surface using wooden mallet
put spacers between tiles (if required) to minimize imperfections
protect the tiled area from damage during & after fixing of tiles
provide tile trims and strips at corner joints as per requirement

modules.module_title: Check for line, level and alignment

pcs.pc_description: check and provide required level and specified slope prior to and after tiling
check vertical and horizontal alignment using appropriate tools during and after tiling
set out 90-degree angle at corners using builders square or 3-4-5 method

modules.module_title: Carry out preparatory work for grouting of tile, stone, marble and granite works

pcs.pc_description: read and interpret the working drawings / sketches prior to commencement of work
ensure curing of placed stone, marble & granite tiles
ensure joints of tiles are free from debris & carry out vacuum cleaning of the grout lines
remove thoroughly old grouting compound with appropriate tools prior to re-grouting on old surface
prepare different types of grouts as per surface requirements and manufacturers specifications
check grout material is of approved color and shade & as per pattern
check that grout material is of approved type (sanded, un sanded, ) as per design/pattern requirements

modules.module_title: Apply grout and sealant to seal the void or gap between the tiles, stones, marble & granite

pcs.pc_description: apply the grout between grout lines/joints using appropriate tool
press the grout into the joint using appropriate tools and technique
handle grout float edge properly and prevent it from digging out the grout lines
use appropriate amount of penetrating sealant on the stones prior to fixing as per applicability
remove excess grout from the surface to avoid any grout haze on the surface
check and ensure that the grout was cured prior to application of sealant
polish the surface after application of grout in case of epoxy grouts for better aesthetics and smoother joints
add additive to cementations grouts as a substitute for water as per specifications
ensure proper care is taken for moisture sensitive and light colored natural stones to prevent strain ingress
ensure proper protective layer at the corners(tile trims/strips) of tiled surfaces

modules.module_title: Check for line , level & alignment

pcs.pc_description: check and provide required level and specified slope
check vertical and horizontal alignment using appropriate tools

modules.module_title: Carry out preparatory work for polishing work

pcs.pc_description: ensure the work area is clean and free of debris.
check and verify the type of tiles (marble, granite, ceramic, etc.) and the required finish.
check marble / tile polishing tools and adequate size of pads
ensure adequate lighting and ventilation in the work area

modules.module_title: Use of Tools and Equipment for polishing work

pcs.pc_description: select appropriate polishing pads, abrasives or compounds based on tile type
operate the polishing machines (handheld or machine operated)
inspect and the machine regularly

modules.module_title: Polishing process

pcs.pc_description: remove surface irregularities and scratches by using coarse abrasive
use finer abrasives for a smooth and shiny finish progressively
maintain consistent pressure and movement to avoid uneven polishing or damage to tiles
polish the edges and corners evenly
ensure the use of the correct amount of water or polishing solution, if required
wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), such as gloves, masks, and goggles.
handle chemicals and polishing agents safely, ensuring no spills or contamination.
ensure proper disposal of waste materials, adhering to environmental guidelines.

modules.module_title: Post Polishing tasks

pcs.pc_description: clean the tiles to remove residual polish or debris
inspect the polished surface for quality assurance
report any defects or issues to the supervisor
restore tools and equipment to their proper storage location
